profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Atomic Object | Product-minded, AI-forward
profile.summary:
Product-minded engineer who works best alongside design and the people deciding what to build. Over four years as a software consultant across mobile and web stacks, most recently as a tech lead shaping product direction with clients. Lately, excited about building the agentic workflows my teams ship with.

Outside of my tech career I serve as the board secretary for Common Bond Basketball LLC, the grassroots organization that I grew up playing with and who ultimately sent me off to play ball in college.

I enjoy giving back to the places that raised me, and I actively seek opportunities to mentor others both personally and professionally.

Nowadays, my personal time goes towards being a dog dad, working out, playing games and cooking.

positions.title: Presidential Student Advisor for Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
positions.description:
This board of students served as a direct counsel to the university president, with the mission of better serving BIPOC students and faculty in Calvin’s ecosystem.

I had the opportunity to lead our team’s efforts to research and survey the student population on their experiences, identify opportunities and shortcomings, and support the President in making decisions that would affect the next several generations of students.

That includes, but is not limited to: participating in curriculum redesign, advocating for representation amongst faculty/staff and student enrollment, and engaging with local politicians and authorities on policy.

positions.title: President - CISD Student Ambassadors
positions.description: The CISD Ambassadors are a group of students who serve the multicultural community of students at Calvin. We work under the Center for Intercultural Student Development, and plan various programs and events for on and off campus students.

positions.title: Program Director
positions.description: LEAD (Learn, Educate, Act, Diversify) is a student-run social justice and advocacy group at Calvin University. LEAD’s function is to facilitate social justice conversations and projects on behalf of the Calvin Athletic Department and help nurture community partnerships between Calvin and the greater Grand Rapids area.
